content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define mutation and explain how mutations occur
Describe different types of gene mutations
Explain the effects mutations can have on proteins and organisms
Discuss factors that increase mutation rate

Frameshift mutation example using a sentence analogy:
Original: THE CAT SAT (reads correctly in groups of 3)
Deletion of one letter: TH_ CAT SAT
Result: THE ATS AT… (frame shifts — all following codons are read incorrectly)
Frameshift mutations are usually severe because:
Every codon after the mutation is affected
The entire amino acid sequence is changed
Larger-scale changes affecting parts or whole chromosomes.
